# ImproveAnyTask

ImproveAnyTask is an autonomous post-training harness for iterative and recursive self-improvement of large language models.

## Core idea

The harness repeatedly connects three modules:
1. Error Attribution uses aggregate metrics and individual failure cases to identify a focal problem.
2. Update Direction compares research-backed strategies by expected gain, applicability, and reproduction difficulty.
3. Executable Model Updates translates the selected strategy into training data and a training configuration, with execution checks before full post-training.

## Main findings

- Evaluated on 11 benchmarks across five capability domains.
- Mean improvement of 18.29 percentage points on Qwen3.5-4B-Base.
- Mean improvement of 11.97 percentage points on Qwen3.5-4B-Instruct.
- Maximum improvement of 41.96 percentage points on LiveCodeBench v6.
- Each optimization uses a 24-hour budget with resources equivalent to eight NVIDIA H20 GPUs.

## Research topics

Recursive self-improvement (RSI), recursive model self-improvement, iterative model self-improvement, self-evolving AI, autonomous model improvement, autonomous post-training, task-specific LLM adaptation, agent harnesses, error attribution, data curation, supervised fine-tuning, benchmark optimization.
